|lore=Pilots are often reassigned at the last minute for a variety of tactical reasons. Darth Vader ordered DS-61-2 and DS-61-3 to accompany him to the Battle of Yavin.
|game_text=Use 1 Force to target a starfighter’s permanent pilot. Draw destiny. If destiny > 2, deploy on starfighter to remove permanent pilot (otherwise, Effect is lost). May add 1 pilot. (Immune to Alter.)

|rulings=* The Effect increases the targeted starfighter’s pilot capacity by one. It can target either player’s starfighter but does not permit Dark Side pilots to deploy to a Light Side starfighter. It does not target squadrons.<ref>[[:File:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary (1998)]], page 38; [[:File:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]], page 2.</ref>
* When the target has more than one permanent pilot, the 2002 supplement removes all permanent pilots.<ref>[[:File:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]], page 2.</ref>
